tests: W2-128 round2a + W1-35 orchestration: 47 passed, 2 failed, 27 deselected. The failures are `test_s11_guard_test_design_skill_changes_only_its_read_rule` (expected, a designer is revising it) and `test_s11_guard_orchestration_skill_changes_only_the_named_parts` (not expected). `gov accept DAEO-k7hz` (exit 3, fail): 186 passed, 7 failed, 1 skipped in total. success-6 has 1 failure, success-11 has 2, unmapped has 4. Every other line passes.
discoveries: Until now the orchestration guard stopped at its first check: the heading at index 13 did not match. With the heading fixed, it goes on to compare the text line by line against W2-128's pinned baseline (61231e61839e), and 9 of 13 sections now differ. Those differences were merged before this round, for decisions such as DEC-1050, DEC-847, DEC-733, DEC-968, DEC-818 and DEC-861/862. Examples are "no fixed number of tickets in flight" and the role-lead.md template. My edits did not cause them. Matching the baseline would mean undoing merged decisions, and the body is at its cap, so the text cannot meet this case. The pin needs revising, the same way the designer is revising the test-design guard.
risks: The orchestration body is now 9,981 of 10,000 characters (2,496 of 2,500 tokens), so it has almost no room for further edits.
lessons: Fixing a test's first failed check can reveal later checks that were never reached. Run the failing test with `--tb=short` after each fix.
proposed_decisions: P-W2-11-R7-1: give the designer the orchestration guard alongside the test-design guard, and move its baseline to the integration branch's merged head, or free the lines merged since 61231e61839e. I recommend this (confidence: high). The other option is to bring the text back to the baseline, which would undo merged decisions.
unresolved: `test_s11_guard_orchestration_skill_changes_only_the_named_parts` (fix is in the test, not the text) and `test_s11_guard_test_design_skill_changes_only_its_read_rule` (designer is on it). I did not look into the other `gov accept` failures (the 4 unmapped, and the rest of success-6 and success-11) because the brief asked for counts only.
recommended_next_action: The ticket lead sends both W2-128 guard cases to the designer to move their baseline, then reruns the W2-128 and W1-35 suites.
